(e) On November 5, 2026, the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of Blue Bird Corporation (the “Company”) took certain actions regarding our executive officers, as described below. John F. Wyskiel . The Compensation Committee approved an increase in the annual base salary of Mr. John Wyskiel, our Chief Executive Officer, effective December 27, 2026. Mr. Wyskiel will now receive an annual base salary of $1,000,000. In addition, the Compensation Committee approved an increase to Mr. Wyskiel’s long-term equity incentive plan ("LTIP") target bonus value equal to 400% of his annual base salary (previously equal to 250% of annual base salary), which shall be applied beginning with LTIP awards for fiscal 2027, to be awarded in December 2026. Mr. Wyskiel’s management incentive program ("MIP") payout will be consistent with the program payout of 200% of the MIP target of 125% of base salary; however, based upon the exceptional performance of Mr. Wyskiel managing numerous long term growth projects for the benefit of the Company, the Committee determined to award an additional multiplier of 125% of the total MIP award, resulting in a total Fiscal 2026 MIP payment of $2,709,375. Razvan Radulescu. The Compensation Committee approved an increase in the annual base salary of Mr. Razvan Radulescu, our Chief Financial Officer, effective December 27, 2026. Mr. Radulescu will now receive an annual base salary of $643,000. In addition, the Compensation Committee approved an increase to Mr. Radulescu’s LTIP target bonus value equal to 175% of his annual base salary (previously equal to 150% of annual base salary), which shall be applied beginning with LTIP awards for fiscal 2027, to be awarded in December 2026. Mr. Radulescu’s MIP payout will be consistent with the program payout of 200% of the MIP target of 100% of base salary; however, based upon the exceptional performance of Mr. Radulescu managing numerous long term growth projects for the benefit of the Company, the Committee determined to award an additional multiplier of 120% of the total MIP award, resulting in a total Fiscal 2026 MIP payment of $1,497,600. Ted M. Scartz. The Compensation Committee approved an increase in the annual base salary of Mr. Ted M. Scartz, our Chief Legal Officer, effective December 27, 2026. Mr. Scartz will now receive an annual base salary of $500,000. Mr. Scartz’s LTIP target bonus value remains equal to 125% of his annual base salary, which shall be applied beginning with LTIP awards for fiscal 2027, to be awarded in December 2026. Mr. Scartz’s MIP payout will be consistent with the program payout of 200% of the MIP target of 65% of base salary; however, based upon the exceptional performance of Mr. Scartz managing numerous long term growth projects for the benefit of the Company, the Committee determined to award an additional multiplier of 125% of the total MIP award, resulting in a total Fiscal 2026 MIP payment of $739,375. Jeffrey S. Sanfrey. The Compensation Committee approved an increase in the annual base salary of Mr. Jeffrey S. Sanfrey, our Chief Operating Officer, effective December 27, 2026. Mr. Sanfrey will now receive an annual base salary of $446,000. Mr. Sanfrey’s LTIP target bonus value remains equal to 100% of his annual base salary, which shall be applied beginning with LTIP awards for fiscal 2027, to be awarded in December 2026. Mr. Sanfrey’s MIP payout will be consistent with the program payout of 200% of the MIP target of 65% of base salary; however, based upon the exceptional performance of Mr. Sanfrey managing numerous long term growth projects for the benefit of the Company, the Committee determined to award an additional multiplier of 110% of the total MIP award, resulting in a total Fiscal 2026 MIP payment of $619,190. The Company’s LTIP and other incentive compensation programs are described in detail in the Company’s Definitive Proxy Statement dated January 26, 2026, with respect to its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on January 26, 2026.
